text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'A calibrated forecast lies on the dashed diagonal. 35 batteries, issued 18:00 the day before. Above the diagonal at a low level, or below it at a high level, means outcomes fall outside the forecast more often than it says.'
text.tspan: A calibrated forecast lies on the dashed diagonal. 35 batteries, issued 18:00 the day before. Above the diagonal at
a low level, or below it at a high level, means outcomes fall outside the forecast more often than it says.
